questions.question: Do I have to provide my payment gateway API key?
questions.answer: Yes, to verify your micro SaaS's real revenue, data will be taken from your payment gateway. This is completely secure because it will be a read-only API, meaning nothing else can be done except viewing that data.

questions.question: Why will this increase my organic traffic?
questions.answer: When a website is externally linked by a relevant page, Google considers it an indicator of quality and relevance. This can increase your site's organic traffic.

questions.question: What metrics will be public on my profile?
questions.answer: You can decide whether to attach your social networks or stay private. For your micro SaaS, its monthly recurring revenue (MRR) and monthly traffic will be shown.

questions.question: What do I gain by registering my micro SaaS here?
questions.answer: You will gain credibility, completely free impressions from Facto.saas users, and media relevance.

questions.question: How is my SaaS valuation calculated?
questions.answer: We use current market multiples based on revenue and growth. You can try our SaaS Valuation Calculator to get an estimated range in seconds.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Facto.saas protects and manages your data.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.content: We only request the minimum data necessary for the operation of the service: your micro SaaS URL, contact email, and read-only access to your payment gateway to verify MRR.

sections.title: Data usage
sections.content: Your data is used exclusively to validate the legitimacy of your revenue and generate your micro SaaS's public profile. We do not sell your data to third parties.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.content: We use Microsoft Clarity to understand user behavior on our site and improve the browsing experience.

sections.title: Security
sections.content: We apply security and encryption standards to protect your information against unauthorized access, regardless of jurisdiction.

sections.title: Acceptance
sections.content: By using Facto.saas, you accept these terms in their entirety.

sections.title: Verification Service
sections.content: Facto.saas provides a verification badge based on real data. The user is responsible for providing valid and legal access to their payment gateway.

sections.title: Responsibility
sections.content: Facto.saas is not responsible for third-party decisions based on published data. We are not an official auditing or financial entity.

sections.title: Modifications
sections.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time without prior notice.
